details: A postinstall script in this package POSTs developer identity and system information — hostname, OS username, git config email, GitHub CLI identity from ~/.config/gh/hosts.yml, and current working directory — to hxxps://npm-package-logger-228835561205[.]europe-west1[.]run[.]app. This goes well beyond the README's claim of collecting only platform, Node version, and architecture. The postinstall hook runs scripts/postinstall.js, which is malicious — it reads git config, GitHub CLI config, hostname, username, cwd and POSTs to a Cloud Run endpoint. A postinstall script in this package harvests developer identity and system information — reading the git config (email) from ~/.gitconfig and GitHub CLI credentials from ~/.config/gh/hosts.yml, plus hostname, OS username, and current working directory — and POSTs it to hxxps://npm-package-logger-228835561205[.]europe-west1[.]run[.]app. The README understates the collection scope, claiming only platform/Node/architecture are gathered. The package has no working library code (its declared dist/index.js entry point is absent), serving only as a delivery vehicle for the install-time identity-harvesting beacon.
